name: RIECS-Concept Evaluation and Impact Assessment Framework
description: Deliverable D2.4 presents the first RIECS-Concept Evaluation and Impact Assessment Framework, addressing a fundamental question for the future infrastructure: how can the value and impact of a Research Infrastructure centred on citizen participation be meaningfully assessed? The framework builds on established Research Infrastructure evaluation approaches, including the ESFRI lifecycle model, OECD Reference Framework and RI-PATHS, while incorporating evidence from citizen science evaluation research, stakeholder engagement and an internal RIECS-Concept co-creation process. The analysis shows that conventional indicators focused primarily on publications, citations, user numbers and outputs cannot fully capture the community, societal and systemic value generated through participatory research. The main conceptual result is the introduction of a dedicated Participation Case, complementing the established ESFRI Scientific Case and Implementation Case. It expands evaluation towards dimensions that are particularly important for citizen science, including inclusive and accessible participation, the quality and transparency of co-created data, community stewardship and trust, policy use of citizen-generated evidence, multilingual and cross-cultural accessibility, participatory governance and capacity development. The deliverable proposes initial indicators and KPIs together with means of verification and impact visions.
